turns.sentence: Hi there! Table for how many?
Sure. Right this way. Here's your menu.
Thank you. Can I get a coffee first?
Excuse me, I think there's been a mix-up with my order.
Oh, I'm so sorry about that. What did you order?
I asked for the grilled chicken, not the fried one.
You're absolutely right, my mistake. I'll get that fixed for you right away.
No worries, these things happen. Thanks for sorting it out.
I appreciate your patience — I'll also take the drink off your bill.
Would it be possible to substitute the fries for a side salad instead?
Absolutely, that shouldn't be a problem at all — would you like the house dressing with that?
That'd be great, thanks. Also, I should mention I've got a fairly severe nut allergy.
Thank you for letting me know — I'll flag that with the kitchen so they can double-check every dish.
I really appreciate you taking it seriously.
Of course — we'd rather ask twice than take any chances with something like that.
